report:
Reviewed complete query_capture claim and all six ordinary implementation associations: host driver, database event capture, CompileTest preparation, observe collector, symbol freezing and type freezing. No TODO/N/A entries exist. Each preparation creates an isolated project and SageHost; driver open constructs new Database storage and registers text/configuration after provider readiness, without calling setup_root_module or semantic checking. prepare drains setup inspection events before with_context. with_context then calls tracked setup_root_module; collect calls check_crate, which recursively discovers local modules and demands signatures and supported bodies independent of selectors. walk_expr freezes type and symbol names (including external definition paths) before collect drains inspection events. Database request events and drain semantics preserve the actual cold demand. Trace projection consumes the drained owned vector and preserves operations/dispositions; it has no database access.

The complete associated tests are cold_queries_are_stable_across_isolated_projects and cold_capture_includes_discovery_and_observation_reads_without_changing_bodies. The former compares fresh projects, asserts executed body work and excludes unstable path/ID strings. The added real fixture uses an external enum variant and a second unselected private function. It asserts the resolved external symbol, equality of the real trace with/without a symbol selector, executed root discovery, signature, body and external def_path reads, and exactly two executed local bodies. These assertions detect pre-demanding products before capture, dropping discovery/signatures, dropping observation-related metadata reads and selector-limited checking. Frozen boundary is additionally established by direct source inspection: events are drained before formatting observations/diagnostics and query projection, FrozenType Display uses only owned values, and expectation comparison occurs after prepare returns. This is structural evidence, not a claim that a dedicated boundary-injection test ran. Optional query omission produces an empty query string; enabling it projects the captured events. Warm runs, edits and point demands are explicitly future extensions, not missing v1 behavior.

Validation executed: cargo fmt; cargo test -p sage-test-harness cold_capture_includes_discovery -- --nocapture passed; cargo test -p sage-test-harness cold_queries_are_stable_across_isolated_projects -- --nocapture passed; cargo build passed with existing warnings. Initial exploratory call fixtures encountered unrelated inference/parser limitations and were replaced by a supported external variant fixture without changing diagnostic markers. Central post-codegen and Sage sanity review are coordinated by the parent. No production behavior changes were made; added test evidence and the essential database capture association. Source dependencies read for assessment are captured in this review.
